correctness.rationale: For every r,Lambda,t>0, conditional Gaussianity is exact. Bath regeneration proves its invariant Laplace distribution and bulk CLT. Generator moments give covariance and full-time fourth cumulant. Matching Gaussian-mixture logarithmic upper/lower bounds give sharp Weibull exponent and coefficient. A Riccati transform calculation and Poisson cycle bound give the finite-moment domain, including its boundary. The extracted checker independently tests the algebra and Riccati solutions. Analytic proof, not finite simulation, establishes the universal limits.

value.rationale: Selective refresh of a stochastic medium is a distinct physical protocol explicitly motivated in the parent paper. Exact Gaussian-bulk coexistence with a sharp 2/3-power rare-tail rate and all-time absence of exponential moments is a structural distinction, and the independently measurable monotone kurtosis provides a quantitative finite-horizon signature. The theorem applies for every positive bath-noise strength and Poisson rate, not an arbitrary finite slice.
